title: The first WordCamp, Swedish American Hall, San Francisco
alt: A wood-panelled hall with a balcony. Rows of folding chairs fill the floor; people stand talking in small groups between them and lean on the balcony rail above.
caption: The Swedish American Hall in San Francisco during a break at the first WordCamp, 5 August 2006 — announced twenty-seven days earlier without a venue.
creator: Zach Petersen

title: Contributor Day, WordCamp Europe 2026, Kraków
alt: Seen from a balcony: a dark hall filled with round white tables, each ringed with people working at laptops.
caption: Contributor Day at WordCamp Europe in Kraków, 4 June 2026.
creator: Jeroen Rotty / WordCamp Europe

title: b2/cafelog 0.6.2.1: the Post / Edit screen
alt: A plain web form: a b2 logo, a row of menu links, fields for a title and category, a large empty box for the post with formatting buttons above it, and a list showing one post titled “Hello world !”.
caption: b2’s writing screen, version 0.6.2.1 — the software WordPress was forked from. The screenshot is a later re-run of the old code, made for the project’s official history; the first post already says “Hello world !”.
creator: From “Milestones: The Story of WordPress”
changes: Resized and re-encoded. The image carries no licence of its own; the software shown is GPL.

title: WordPress 1.2: the Write screen
alt: An early WordPress admin page: the word WordPress in serif type, a menu beginning Write, Edit, Categories, Links, and a form with a title field, a post box with a row of small formatting buttons, and a Publish button.
caption: The Write screen of WordPress 1.2, in a later re-run made for the official history. “Plugins” has just appeared in the menu.
creator: From “Milestones: The Story of WordPress”
changes: Resized and re-encoded. The image carries no licence of its own; the software shown is GPL. (The book labels it 1.5; its footer reads 1.2.)

title: The admin after MP6: Add New Post, WordPress 3.9 beta
alt: A WordPress admin screen with a dark sidebar menu on the left, a blue highlight on the current item, and a white editing area with a toolbar and a Publish box on the right.
caption: The admin design that began as the MP6 plugin and shipped in WordPress 3.8, seen here in a 3.9 beta: a dark sidebar, and a layout that adapts to small screens.
creator: From “Milestones: The Story of WordPress”
changes: Resized and re-encoded. The image carries no licence of its own; the software shown is GPL.

title: Kubrick on a WordPress 1.5 test site, February 2005
alt: A real screenshot of the Kubrick theme: a blue rounded header reading “WordPress 1.5 Testing”, a “Hello world!” post, and a sidebar.
caption: Screenshot: a WordPress 1.5 test site in Kubrick, February 2005. Its blogroll lists Matt, Carthik, Donncha, Ryan, Dougal, Mike, Alex and Michel.
creator: Uploader not named; via Wikimedia Commons
